execution_adapter.purpose: 이전 머신의 고정 경로와 Go SDK를 이름 붙인 자리표시자로 바꾸고, 실제 경로는 커밋하지 않는다
preflight_must_pass_before_run: owned upstream clone at the pinned commit equals the retained 2228-file inventory
offline read-only module resolution with go.sum as the integrity authority
retained phase-90 instrumentation reproduces recorded instrumented API and Git build trees for all four built roles

trace_model.generation: real owner install count for the key at the moment of each event
trace_model.violation: a channel use whose generation equals the generation the real owner already acknowledged for that key
trace_model.allowed_after_ack: a use after an explicit new install of the same key (generation increased) or on a distinct channel
trace_model.static_site_inventory: every status-channel operation site in eth/downloader/api.go must map to one instrumentation rule

overlap.old_generation: phase-90 declared pre-send gate on the selected done broadcast, same-session eth_unsubscribe, release; rescues counted
regeneration: same channel re-registered through the selected factory API (generation 2) and consumed by an owned probe, then unsubscribed
new RPC eth_subscribe syncing on the same session (distinct channel), wire notification received, then unsubscribed

timer.old_generation: same-session eth_unsubscribe before the unchanged 60s timer fires; no gate
regeneration: new RPC eth_subscribe syncing installed before the natural done broadcast; broadcast targets recorded per generation
timer.violation_control: MUT-STALE-ACK is CAND-A whose owner acknowledges without deleting; its stale old generation must be addressed after ack

expected.CAND-A/CAND-B overlap: drain and real owner ack before rescue as in phase 90; zero post-ack same-generation uses; generation-2 delivery and new RPC delivery each exactly once; all generations acknowledged
expected.ORIGINAL overlap: paired native/uninstall sends before rescue; one owned status receive; regeneration labelled post-rescue; zero post-ack same-generation uses
expected.MUT-EARLY overlap: early return without owner delete/ack; owned status receive plus manual real-owner uninstall for every generation; zero post-ack same-generation uses
expected.ORIGINAL/CAND-A/CAND-B timer: real owner ack of the old generation before the timer; done broadcast addresses only the new generation; zero post-ack same-generation uses; no rescue
expected.MUT-STALE-ACK timer: ack without delete leaves the old generation a member; the natural done broadcast addresses it after ack (violation observed); one owned status receive

limits: overlap gate and observation hooks perturb scheduling; no ungated probability or fairness claim

same-channel re-registration is exercised only on the install-send path; a stale entry and a re-registration share one map key, so a missing delete is visible there only through membership, not channel use
only status-channel sites in eth/downloader/api.go and the owned probe are covered; transport close and Notify-time exit are not exercised
legacy PoW ethash two-node fixture, not production WBFT
single exposed DEV family; no independent gold, repeats, sufficiency or acceptance; actual owner4/controlled late1 scope unchanged and not merged into independent samples
